{{Top|leg|canon=Fungus Farms}}
'''Fungus farms''' where underground facilities where nutritious fungi were harvested, which were often of immense size. They were usually located at the bottom levels of a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] household, where the air temperature was more suitable for proper fungi growth. The fungus (including [[Mulch mold]] and [[li fungus]]) was often fed to Neimoidian children, but was exported offworld to other markets as well. Dangerous spores were known to be released from the fungi, promoting some medical problems when inhaled. Some [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who entered a fungus farm experienced the sensation of "dislocation".
